{{Top|leg}}
'''Shollo''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While transporting a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] using a [[Model S-3]] [[force cage]], Shollo gave him a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to read. The prisoner used the circuitry in the datapad to bypass the shockers in the cage floor, then escape using some dinner utensils.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
